Data:Skaptodon.fang.json.Label: Skaptodon Fang
Data:Skaptodon.fang.json.Desc: It is rare for the Lionsmith to make skaptodons, now; but they are difficult to kill, and they live a very long time.

Data:Skill.chandlery.json.label: Chandlery
Data:Skill.chandlery.json.desc: A skill that can be used, with suitable ingredients, to make candles. [The most likely ingredients are beeswax and herbs; but to confound villagers and visitors, leave a meaningful pause before the word 'suitable.']

Data:Skill.json.label: Skill
Data:Skill.json.desc: Anything can be learnt; everything can be forgotten.

Data:Skill.language.json.label: Language
Data:Skill.language.json.desc: A skill that can be used to read particular books, among other much less important things.

Data:Skill.missing.ability.hint.json.label: Soul?
Data:Skill.missing.ability.hint.json.startdescription: Skill without effort is like tea without boiling water. No-one wants to eat tea-leaves. [Add a Soul card.]

Data:Skill.missing.skill.hint.json.label: Skill?
Data:Skill.missing.skill.hint.json.startdescription:
I'm ready; but for what?

Data:Skinshuck.mead.json.Label: Skinshuck Mead
Data:Skinshuck.mead.json.Desc: A murky, sweet-smelling liquid crowded with sediment.

xexts.scrutiny: Moth's gift to the devotees Old Form, so they could shed their skins and don the skins of beasts. After a few gulps, my skin will begin to peel as if I had spent too long in the sun. [With the great arts of Moth-aspect, perhaps this could be brewed from honey.]

Data:Skull.contained.json.Label: Contained Skull
Data:Skull.contained.json.Desc: A skull sealed firmly beneath a glass dome, possibly to prevent misbehaviour.

xexts.scrutiny: The skull is not currently misbehaving.

Data:Skull.json.Label: Cranial Tchotchke
Data:Skull.json.Desc: We all of us come to this condition in the end, but not all of us are fortunate enough to be lovingly buffed and fixed carefully to a stylish wooden stand.

xexts.scrutiny: There is no sign of any cranial trauma; rule that out as a cause of death.

Data:Skull.x.json.Label: Glinting Cranial Tchotchke
Data:Skull.x.json.Desc: We all of us come to this condition in the end, but not all of us are fortunate enough to be lovingly buffed and fixed carefully to a stylish wooden stand.

xexts.scrutiny: There is no sign of any cranial trauma; rule that out as a cause of death.

Data:Sky.json.label: Sky
Data:Sky.json.desc: Wind, storm, echo, song; the intricacies of mathematics and the principles of flight. Law's touch is lighter than we sometimes think. [Matters of balance, harmony and necessity.]

Data:Sky.only.hint.json.label: Now What?
Data:Sky.only.hint.json.startdescription: There's potential here. [Start by adding a Soul card.]

Data:Slab.serpentinite.json.Label: Serpentinite Slab
Data:Slab.serpentinite.json.Desc: The grey-green root-rock of the Cornish coast.

Data:Sleepytime.json.label: Sleeping Hours
Data:Sleepytime.json.desc: The righteous should be tucked up in bed; the unrighteous are probably about their unrighteous work.
